corrective_reason: Author faithful original Girtas front-facing SOUTH hit reaction, with true backward-away body/neck recoil and anatomical right weapon on image-left.
prompt:
Create ONE production isometric RPG game-animation sheet: SIX genuine full-body HIT-REACTION poses of exactly 지배자 기르타스 (Girtas), all facing SOUTH / SCREEN DOWN / FRONT. Use ONLY the attached original portrait and faithful canonical identity. Preserve the pale visible face, long pale/white hair, exact gold head structure, narrow needle-like golden radial back-spines, dark gold-edged armor, long dark gold-trimmed skirt, solid inset gold chest emblem and ONE long sinuous original glowing weapon. No red mask or substitute demon face, no shortened skirt, no broad replacement wings, no different weapon. Same original humanoid proportions and complete equipment in all six.

ABSOLUTE DIRECTION: All SIX show a true SOUTH/front view, facing the viewer toward the BOTTOM of the image under the same elevated orthographic isometric camera. Both sides of the FRONT pale face and FRONT chest armor are visible; the nose and chest point screen-DOWN. Do not reuse the canonical three-quarter head angle. Never turn face, chest, hips or toes toward screen left/right, northwest or away from the viewer. Even at maximum recoil the face stays frontal and chest remains front-facing. Recoil is a PITCH backward away into the screen, not a yaw toward either side. The radial gold needles remain attached behind both shoulders, seen around the front body with correct depth occlusion.

ANATOMICAL HAND CONTRACT: The single sinuous original weapon is held in the character's anatomical RIGHT hand, which appears on IMAGE LEFT in this SOUTH/front view. The IMAGE-RIGHT hand is the unarmed anatomical LEFT. All SIX must preserve that same assignment. Keep the long weapon low beside image-left thigh/boot with its full original sinuous blade visible; it follows wrist inertia during the hit. Do not mirror handedness, put a second weapon in the free hand, or make an attack/slash.

Six real chronological impact phases, order left-to-right then down: (0) stable SOUTH front idle brace, both original boots supporting, right-hand weapon at IMAGE LEFT; (1) a blow arriving FROM THE FRONT/SCREEN BOTTOM jolts chest and shoulders BACKWARD/AWAY toward SCREEN UP, knees flex and free arm reacts, face still front; (2) MAXIMUM backward-away torso/head recoil, coherent spine/neck/hip pitch, chin lifts while the PALE FACE remains frontal, knees and elbows articulate, long hair/skirt lag physically; (3) balanced stagger, one original foot braces a little farther back UP-screen while the other supports down-screen, hips counterbalance and torso begins regaining control, all still front-facing; (4) recovery from recoil, torso rises over coherent feet, arms/hair/skirt settle and weapon remains non-offensive at image left; (5) recovered SOUTH guard, stable original body with a distinct final settling pose. The figure keeps its body heading and support logic through all six, does not turn into a side-facing fighter. Show clearly different shoulder/neck/elbow/hip/knee/ankle positions and readable maximum body reaction at phase2. No repeated drawing, global translation/rotation, tint/opacity substitute, camera movement, blur, mirrored copies, death fall or offensive weapon strike.

TECHNICAL MINIATURE ATLAS: PNG1024x1536, EXACTLY TWO COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, six512x512 cells. The six figures are deliberately SMALL: nominal helmet-to-boot BODY height about260px, complete silhouette at most300x300px including EVERY narrow radial needle, full sinuous weapon tip, hair, skirt and boots. Center each whole figure in the central300x300 area of its own cell, with at least106px of completely empty transparent margin on EVERY cell edge. More than70percent of the sheet remains empty. DO NOT ENLARGE THE FIGURES TO FILL THE PAGE. Use one identical actual head/torso/feet pixel scale across all six, not smaller heads or limbs in a particular pose. Re-angle actual attached gear coherently; never crop, shorten, remove or detach it. No overlap of character bounding rectangles or cross-cell blur/glow.

Crisp detailed game cutouts, readable pale face and hair, gold trim, fully opaque dark armor/skirt. Gold/fire brightness stays confined inside original solid chest/needle/weapon surfaces. Alpha0 everywhere outside exact silhouettes and in gaps. Edge antialiasing only1-2pixels. No floor, shadows, background panels, diffuse aura, halo, haze, bloom, fog, debris, long trail, motion blur, text, labels or grid. The final sheet must be SIX distinct readable front-facing SOUTH hit responses of the faithful original Girtas, with the same anatomical RIGHT weapon on IMAGE LEFT throughout.

visual_findings: Absolute compass: all six figures show SOUTH/screen-down front view, with frontal pale face and front chest emblem/armor visible. No left/right body yaw or side-view substitution occurs during recoil.

Anatomical right hand is consistently at IMAGE LEFT and holds the same one long sinuous original weapon in all six phases. IMAGE RIGHT is the unarmed left hand. The weapon stays low, without an offensive slash or hand swap.

Phase0 braces; phase1 lifts chin and pitches shoulders/chest backward-away; phase2 has maximum coherent torso/head recoil and a different free elbow/hip/knee configuration. Face remains frontal while the neck pitches back.

Phase3 uses staggered original feet and flexed knees to counterbalance, with lowered shoulders and an extending free arm. Phase4 regains the torso over the feet; phase5 settles into frontal guard with distinct foot/arm/hair placement.

Actual articulated head, shoulders, torso, arms, hips, knees and support stance change through the sequence; this is not global translation, tint/opacity, repeated portrait frames or an attack sequence.

Pale uncovered face, long pale/white hair, thin radial gold back-spines, original gold head structure, dark gold-trimmed armor and long dark skirt remain faithful to the original/canonical identity. The full weapon and boot/spine tips remain visible.

Unchanged strict analyzer plus complete-pose-region gate pass six complete distinct poses. Generated pixels remain untouched; no cropping, resampling, manual body edits, broad glow masking or validator relaxation.
visual_limitations: Private source review only; SpriteFrames, actual Player/game linkage, recoil duration, cross-role body scale and final actor quality approval remain outside this task. No character or detailed completion added.

The original portrait is small; tiny facial/trim landmarks remain uncertain, with the faithful canonical reconstruction used as the only detailed identity reference. This uncertainty alone is not automatic rejection.

The generator enlarged figures beyond the requested about260px body /300px complete-silhouette cap. This sparse-layout discrepancy is preserved and reported; do not normalize by full spike/weapon bbox or assume final runtime sizing.
Bright edge light is concentrated along the existing original fiery weapon; final alpha/material review remains separate. No broad cross-cell haze or body-overlap was observed in the bounded preview.
